environment.location: windy stone terrace on a violet void world
environment.light_behavior: violet lightning flickers across faces while the evidence map gives steady under-light

elements.description: Embry Lawson, brown-haired woman in a practical gray jacket
elements.environment_interaction: wind moves loose hair strands and map light reflects in her eyes
elements.action: holds a warm teacup, exhales, then looks from the synthetic dream map to Horus with a careful relieved expression

elements.description: Horus Lupercal, bald armored giant seated calmly across the table
elements.environment_interaction: lantern light traces the gold armor edges while violet lightning crosses one cheek
elements.action: listens without interrupting and turns one teacup gently toward Embry

elements.description: white porcelain tea service beside a glowing evidence map
elements.environment_interaction: steam bends sideways in the wind and map light glows through it
elements.action: remains centered between Embry and Horus as a visual anchor
